description:

This battery comes with a 2 year non-transferable warranty.

name: Ultra Bee 22S (81v 76ah) Version 4 High Power Battery Kit
short_description: These items are a Special Order product, they may not always be available in stock. Please contact us if interested.
description:
If you already own an Ultra Bee, or are thinking about buying one, this bundle is the very best way to upgrade the power on your Ultra Bee.  These batteries come with a two year non-transferable warranty.

  • 88V76Ah
  • Weight :26.5kg
  •  Peak Power: 53kW
  • Nominal capacity: 6688Wh
  • Dimensions (mm):225mm x 177mm x 373mm
  • IP65 Rating
  • High Power Harness

The Bundle Includes:

  • 81v (22S) 76Ah High Power Version 4 Battery
  • 15A Charger*
  • Custom Moulded Lid for Larger Battery

*Please note, if you purchase an Ultra Bee  22S Battery  this is fitted with a 15A Plug (rather than a standard 10A plug). This is due to the charger needing to draw up to 11A. In order to use the charger, you will need a 15Amp outlet.

If you do not have a 15A outlet, you can get an adaptor from any Electrical Hardware Store or Online which will adapt your 10A outlet to 15A.

Please be aware, that while using this solution is effective there is a very low possibility (depending on the RCD’s or RCBO’s in your house, and the wiring you have), this charger could possibly trip your fuse breakers (as it is drawing slightly more than 10a).

If you specifically do not want the 15amp plug then please in notes let us know and we will custom fit a 10amp plug. This will mean you cannot have the fast charger and your battery will take around 7 hours from zero to 100%.

name: 72V 42 Ah Race Battery LBX V5 (Compatible with SurRon Light Bee Only) – Includes Charger
short_description: All batteries are provided with a medium size and longer clip and hinges. If you have a pre-2025 LBX you will need just the medium battery clip, if you have a 2025 model, you will need the longer clip and hinges for the lid to close properly This is due to a difference in the  battery box size with the 2025 model. All parts are supplied in the battery box, please be careful when you open your box and take the battery out you do not miss the clips and hinges embedded into the foam.
description:
Our new V5 high power Race Series SurRon LightBee Battery is a BEAST Power upgrade for your bike. This is Best of the Best!

It has a new look with injection molded Top and QS8 receptacle harness and new Gen 5 Display.

This is a 72v 42ah Battery capable of peak 28kW power (360a peak discharge for 51 seconds until cut off on mosfet temp protection. Voltage drop of 4.4 volts.)

15kW continuous at 200A discharge run for 4 minutes and 16 second continuous load until cut off on mosfet temp protection. Voltage drop of 2.8v.

This is a full plug and play kit that includes thicker wires and QS8 Connectors on the battery-side, custom made harness to replace the air switch.

Battery comes with an extended battery clip to enable it to fit into a SurRon Light Bee without seat extenders.

These batteries come with a two year non-transferable warranty.

Please note: We recommend to get the best operation power pairing this battery with the  EBMX X-9000 Controller. We cannot guarantee that this battery will be compatible with other third party controllers.
